data.description: JPush 是经过考验的大规模 App 推送平台，每天推送消息数超过 5 亿条。 开发者集成 SDK 后，可以通过调用 API 推送消息。同时，JPush 提供可视化的 web 端控制台发送通知，统计分析推送效果。 JPush 全面支持 Android, iOS, Winphone 三大手机平台。
data.label: 极光推送

data.description: JPush is a proven large-scale app push platform, with over 500 million messages pushed daily. After integrating the SDK, developers can push messages by calling the API. JPush also provides a visual web console for sending notifications and analyzing push effects. JPush fully supports Android, iOS, and Winphone platforms.
data.label: Aurora Push
